scope_notes.summary: At reference 18 N, the study names poleward surface and subsurface manifestations Mauritania Current. Its 30–40 km upwelling-season mean undercurrent width is local; the equatorward shelf jet, transport window and broader surface corridor are separate. No whole-current route or annual width range established.

widths.geographic_scope: Reference section at 18 N, pooling coastal measurements from 17–19 N by local bathymetry. Not a uniform whole-coast width.

seasonal_mean_context.averaging_rule: Measurements rotated locally, sorted by water depth, remapped onto reference topography, then assigned to source seasonal means.

widths.section_orientation: Across-shore reference section; rotated alongshore velocity and topographic remapping, not extracted paired edge coordinates.
widths.source_citation: Klenz, Dengler and Brandt (2018), Seasonal Variability of the Mauritania Current and Hydrography at 18 N, JGR: Oceans 123, 8122–8137, doi:10.1029/2018JC014264.
widths.source_locator: Section 5 width statement; section 2.1 and Table 2 sampling/remapping; section 3.1 and Figure 5 seasonal mean context.
widths.source_quality_note: Five upwelling cruises support this mean. August 2016 was excluded from both seasonal means. The 60 km transport window and 200 km surface-flow context are not current widths.
widths.time_convention: December–April upwelling-season convention; five cruises sampled in January–April during 2005–2011 within the study-wide 2005–2016 campaign set. December label is not evidence for sampled December geometry.
